latestVersion.changelog:
Cyber I Ching Master 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Offers digital I Ching divination with classic methods: Milfoil (蓍草法), Coin, and Number-based hexagram generation.
- Provides multi-layered hexagram interpretation (Image, Number, Principle) with detailed Yao explanations.
- Includes BaZi (Four Pillars) chart calculation and rendering.
- Features clear API and CLI usage examples for all functions.
- Adheres to ethical guidelines, restricting prohibited questions.
- Complete project structure and method references documented.
